bugs_found.title: wikigen --help exits with code 1 when output is piped
bugs_found.description: When 'wikigen --help' output is piped (e.g. to 'head'), the process exits with code 1 instead of 0. Running without piping yields exit code 0. The tool appears to detect non-tty stdout and signals a non-zero exit, which may cause false failures in automated pipelines that pipe help output.

bugs_found.title: config show emits 5 repeated keyring warnings without backend suppression
bugs_found.description: Running 'wikigen config show' without PYTHON_KEYRING_BACKEND set produces 5 identical keyring warning lines ('Could not load from keyring: No recommended backend was available'). The warnings are duplicated and noisy; ideally the error would surface once or be gracefully suppressed when no keyring backend is installed.

bugs_found.title: Shared config output_dir points to env-c, not env-a
bugs_found.description: The shared config at /root/.config/wikigen/config.json has output_dir set to '/tmp/wikitest/env-c/output'. This does not match the env-a environment. This is a configuration artifact (shared config across environments) rather than a wikigen code defect, but may cause unexpected output placement if 'wikigen run' is executed in the env-a context without an explicit --output flag.
